observations.statement: Poki reports over 100 million monthly active players.
observations.excerpt: Poki is the world's largest web gaming platform, connecting over 100 million monthly active players around the globe.

observations.statement: Poki splits revenue 50/50 for players arriving via Poki.com or Poki marketing, and gives the developer 100% for players arriving directly.
observations.excerpt: If a user comes to your game directly, through bookmarks, search, social media or through your own community, you get 100% of the revenue for that user. If a user comes to your game through Poki.com, or through a marketing effort from Poki, then Poki splits the revenue 50/50 with you

observations.statement: Poki requires web exclusivity: the same game cannot be published on other web portals or aggregators, while Steam, app stores and consoles remain allowed.
observations.excerpt: That means you can’t publish the same game on other web portals or aggregators — but Steam, app stores, and consoles stay yours; the exclusivity applies to the open web only.

observations.statement: Every game on Poki is hand-picked and daily releases are limited.
observations.excerpt: Every game on Poki is hand-picked. We keep daily releases limited, so each game gets a real shot at being seen.
